notes: Scaffold for law.pro.vn (Professional Authority, legal review magazine). Palette: burgundy #6B1D2A + charcoal #2D2D2D + antique gold #C9A84C on parchment #FAF8F5. Icons: transparent PNG, antique gold, strong/sturdy per F-010. Heroes: editorial magazine photography, long-form reading mood.

images.name: Homepage Hero — Legal Review Magazine
images.prompt: Magazine-cover editorial photograph: an open hardback legal review on a warm walnut desk, morning light from a tall window, an antique gold pen lying across the spread, a cup of black coffee in the soft foreground. Cormorant-Garamond-esque mood — intellectual, contemplative, refined. Deep burgundy leather blotter. No readable text on the page (blur). No people. Composition leaves upper-left negative space for overlaid headline.

images.name: Analysis Article Page Hero
images.prompt: Editorial still life: a stack of legal periodicals on a walnut library table, a single page turned with a margin note hand-written in antique gold ink (illegible), brass reading lamp casting warm tungsten light. Tufte-note aesthetic. No people, no readable text.

images.name: Case Commentary Page Hero
images.prompt: Editorial photograph: an empty legal bench from a partner's perspective — polished dark wood, a leather-bound case file open, an antique gold fountain pen uncapped. Warm morning light. Sophisticated, peer-to-peer, professional. No people, no readable text.

images.name: OG Card — Default
images.prompt: Open-graph social card background: deep burgundy #6B1D2A field, thin antique-gold border frame, a single small gold laurel-leaf mark anchored left, empty right region for overlaid title. Legal-review magazine polish. Readable at 1200x630. No text.

images.name: Icon — Laurel Wreath
images.prompt: Emblematic mark: a bold laurel wreath symbolizing scholarship and legal distinction. Thick confident leaves, symmetrical, sturdy (khoẻ mạnh, cứng cáp). Solid antique gold #C9A84C, flat vector aesthetic. NO letters, NO text inside the wreath. NO background — fully transparent PNG with alpha channel. Centered, generous margins.

images.name: Icon — Quill and Inkwell
images.prompt: Emblematic mark: a traditional quill pen angled into an inkwell, symbolizing legal scholarship and authored analysis. Bold silhouette, strong lines, sturdy. Solid antique gold, flat vector minimal. NO letters, NO text. Fully transparent PNG with alpha channel. Centered.

images.name: Icon — Stack of Law Books
images.prompt: Emblematic mark: a substantial stack of three legal tomes with visible spine ribbing, symbolizing depth of analysis. Bold, weighty, sturdy silhouette. Solid antique gold, flat vector. NO letters, NO text (no titles on spines). Fully transparent PNG with alpha channel. Centered.

images.name: Icon — Legal Compass / Direction
images.prompt: Emblematic mark: a classical mariner's compass rose, symbolizing strategic legal direction. Bold cardinal arms, solid center, symmetrical. Solid antique gold, flat vector. NO letters, NO text, NO cardinal letters (N/S/E/W). Fully transparent PNG with alpha channel. Centered.

images.name: Icon — Analytical Magnifier over Document
images.prompt: Emblematic mark: a classical magnifying glass angled over a small document corner, symbolizing analytical depth. Bold lens, substantial handle, confident silhouette. Solid antique gold, flat vector. NO letters, NO text. Fully transparent PNG with alpha channel. Centered.

images.name: Favicon — Mini Laurel
images.prompt: Simplified laurel-wreath silhouette for a favicon. Extremely legible at 16×16. Solid antique gold on fully transparent PNG with alpha channel. Strong simple shapes, no fine detail. NO letters, NO text.

images.name: Parchment Section Background
images.prompt: Subtle warm parchment texture #FAF8F5 with faint paper fiber and extremely subtle burgundy tint in the shadows, no dominant features, for use as a soft section background. Uniform mood. No text, no images, no symbols.

images.name: Home Cover — Magazine Hero
images.prompt: Cinematic editorial photograph for a legal review magazine cover: a single Vietnamese lawyer's worn leather briefcase resting on the dark walnut floor of an empty courtroom, captured from a low angle. Tall arched windows in the background admit dramatic golden-hour side light, with dust motes visible in the beams. Foreground: a single sheet of legal paper has slipped halfway out of the briefcase, an antique gold fountain pen lying across it. Mood is contemplative, weighty, and quietly authoritative. Burgundy carpet runner, antique-gold accents, parchment-warm shadows. Composition leaves the upper-left third clean for overlaid headline. Absolutely no readable text, no people, no faces.

images.name: Section Hero — Thực tiễn xét xử / Court Practice
images.prompt: Editorial photograph: a Vietnamese courtroom interior viewed from the public gallery — elevated judges' bench in dark walnut, neat rows of empty benches, warm late-afternoon light streaming through tall arched windows, formal but quiet atmosphere. No identifiable faces, no readable text on any document. Burgundy and antique-gold accents, parchment-warm shadows. Composition leaves bottom-left clean for overlaid title.

images.name: Section Hero — Chiến lược hồ sơ / Litigation Strategy
images.prompt: Overhead editorial still life: an organised legal case file on a dark leather desk pad — tabbed manila dividers, a yellow legal pad with handwritten margin notes (illegible), a brass paperweight, an antique gold fountain pen lying across a stack of pleadings. Meticulous arrangement, single warm desk lamp casting strong directional light. Composition leaves bottom-left clean for overlaid title. No readable text, no people.

images.name: Section Hero — Đánh giá chứng cứ / Evidence Assessment
images.prompt: Forensic-aesthetic editorial still life: a polished brass magnifying glass laid across a stack of documents — corner of an envelope with an abstract red wax-style stamp, a handwritten note (illegible) clipped to the side, a single antique gold paperclip catching the light. Dramatic side lighting in burgundy and charcoal tones, deep shadow on one side. Serious, analytical mood. Composition leaves bottom-left clean for overlaid title. No readable text.

images.name: Section Hero — Kỹ năng tranh tụng / Procedural Practice

Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting suggesting an oral-argument moment. No people, no readable text. Sense of authority and presence. Composition leaves bottom-left clean for overlaid title.
